event_summary: A small blue rounded object moves from the left across a wooden surface, passes the right edge area, and exits the frame to the right.
raw_event_description: The scene starts with a light-brown wooden tabletop or cabinet surface beside a pale wall and a translucent pale sheet or panel on the right. After a static interval, a small blue rounded object appears at the left edge on the wooden surface. It moves rightward across the wooden surface with visible blur, reaches the area near the right edge of the wood, continues rightward in front of the pale wall/panel area, and then leaves the frame on the right. The remaining scene stays still after the blue object exits.

reasons: The wooden surface, pale wall, and translucent right-side panel are visible before the moving object appears.
The later moving blue object is not yet visible in the first frame.
